summary: Layer 3 deepening, late firing. First pass completed through chapter 30: chapter 28 gained four records (c28-07, c28-08, c28-10, c28-11; one draft dropped as covered by c28-05), chapter 29 none (every recommendation already tracked), chapter 30 one (c30-05). The second pass over leftover candidates began: Foreword records c00-17 to c00-21 (restating chapter objectives; listed but not counted), chapter 4 records c04-24 to c04-31 and chapter 5 records c05-25 to c05-35; chapter 2 and 3 leftovers were set aside as not publicly checkable. Every new record was independently reviewed by AI and scored blind by two AI raters (c04-29 by a third). Reverse cross-references were added on 55 existing records. The counted set is now 481 recommendations.
